highlights.title: FIT support
highlights.description: Unabara can now import and process .fit files from Garmin/Suunto computers.

highlights.title: One canvas, two views
highlights.description: The overlay tab is now a single large canvas. Edit mode is where you arrange things — drag cells, snap them to the grid, and resize them with the corner handles (the Layout section controls alignment and auto-size). Render mode shows the exact pixels your export will produce.

highlights.title: The Cells panel replaces the Display Options checkboxes
highlights.description: Every cell of the template is listed in the sidebar's Cells section: the eye icon shows or hides it, clicking selects it on the canvas, and badges mark cells with their own font, color or shadow overrides.

highlights.title: The timeline does more than you may think
highlights.description: It zooms, pans, and can be collapsed from its header chevron. The range you zoom into is what "Export only visible time range" exports — the export dialog now shows the exact times next to each range option.

highlights.title: A real Settings tab
highlights.description: Units, template directory, update checks and export defaults now live in their own tab — including the management of your saved camera profiles, which previously could not be edited anywhere.

highlights.title: Templates can theme the dive profile
highlights.description: Templates carry an optional primary/secondary color scheme. Apply it to the dive profile — curve and deco zone take the primary color, indicator and grid the secondary — from the Dive Profile tab's Template Colors section.

changes: Notifications appear as brief toasts instead of pop-up dialogs; export success includes an "Open folder" shortcut.
Exports can be cancelled at any point, including during video encoding.
Both editor sidebars collapse to give the canvas the full width.
Export is available from the Video Preview tab (overlays export with transparency — composited export comes in v0.4).
DejaVu Sans is bundled as the default overlay font, so templates render identically on Linux, macOS and Windows.
New data cells: TTS, CNS, mean and max depth, gas, deco stop depth and time, and CCR PO2 sensors.
